claim_boundary: This is a necessary-condition test of the stated exponent on one frozen ensemble. Satisfying it does not prove Thm 5; violating it would refute the stated bound for the E30 generator. Tail resolution is bounded by the 500 trials per cell.
dispersion_index_interpretation: Variance/mean ratio of X per cell; a value near 1 is consistent with Poisson/Poisson-binomial counting behaviour, which would place the true concentration scale near E[X] rather than near N = n(d-1).
